<thought>After analyzing the mass spectrum (M ≈ 193 Da) and the 13C NMR data (one carbonyl at ~166 ppm, aromatic carbons consistent with a para‑substituted benzene, and four distinct aliphatic carbons including an O‑CH₃ at ~52 ppm), the structure that best fits all observations is methyl 4‑acetylphenyl ether (also called 4‑acetoxy‑anisole). This molecule has 12 carbons, one ester carbonyl, a para‑substituted aromatic ring, and the required aliphatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>COC(=O)C1=CC=C(C)C=C1</final_answer>
